stem.x: Which of the following is the appropriate role of a facilitator in a meeting?

b.x: To act as the chairperson and control the discussions in order to work out a conclusion that matches the intentions of the management
To encourage the meeting participants to express their opinions and organize the flow of discussions from a neutral and impartial position
To offer specialized support for meeting administration, such as adjusting the schedule, preparing materials, or taking minutes.
To provide advice only on discussions related to specific areas in which the facilitator specializes, such as technical or legal fields
